Covered events include fire, theft with forced entry, storm, flood, and sudden escape of water from burst pipes, water tanks or air-conditioning units. Damage from gradual leakage, seepage or damp over time is not covered. A water damage claim carries a higher excess of AED 1,000; the standard excess for other claims is AED 250. Single-item limit: any one item is covered up to AED 7,500 unless it is listed separately on the schedule. Valuables such as jewellery, watches and gold are covered up to 30% of the contents sum insured in total. Replacement is new for old, except clothing and household linen, which are paid less a deduction for wear and tear. Underinsurance: if your contents sum insured is less than the full replacement value of everything you own, claims are reduced in proportion. Optional add-ons: accidental damage, personal belongings away from home up to AED 10,000, and domestic worker liability. Unoccupancy: theft and water damage are not covered if the home has been left empty for more than 45 consecutive days.

title: How to make a home contents claim
text: To claim under HomeShield Contents, call 800 5426 or use the app within 48 hours of discovering the loss or damage. For theft or a break-in, report it to the police within 24 hours and send us the police report. For water damage, stop the source if it is safe to do so, take photos, and keep damaged items until our loss adjuster has seen them. Documents: the completed claim form, photos, original purchase receipts or bank statements showing the purchase, warranty cards, and repair quotes. For claims above AED 15,000, a loss adjuster visits within 3 working days. We settle approved claims within 10 working days of receiving all documents, either by bank transfer or by replacement through our supplier network. Replacement through our suppliers is usually quicker, and electronics are replaced with a model of similar specification. If an item cannot be repaired, it is replaced new for old as set out in the policy, subject to the single-item limit. Clothing and household linen are paid at replacement cost less 10% for each year of age, up to a maximum deduction of 50%. If you disagree with a settlement, ask for a review within 30 days; a senior claims handler not involved in the original decision will reply within 10 working days.

title: Voyager Single Trip travel insurance
text: Voyager Single Trip covers one return journey starting from the UAE, for trips of up to 90 days. It is available to UAE residents aged up to 80 years. Benefits per insured person: emergency medical expenses up to AED 1,000,000; emergency medical evacuation and repatriation; trip cancellation up to AED 7,500; trip curtailment up to AED 7,500; checked baggage loss up to AED 3,000, with AED 750 for any one item; baggage delay of 6 hours or more, AED 500 for essentials; flight delay of AED 150 for each full 6 hours of delay, up to AED 900; and personal liability up to AED 250,000. The policy meets Schengen visa requirements. Excess: AED 250 per claim on medical expenses, cancellation and baggage, and none on flight delay. Pre-existing medical conditions are covered only if declared and accepted before purchase, for an additional premium. Winter sports cover is an optional add-on. Medical and baggage cover starts on the departure date shown on the schedule; cancellation cover starts on the date of purchase, subject to the trip cancellation rules. The policy ends when you return to the UAE or after 90 days, whichever is earlier.

title: Voyager Annual Multi-Trip travel insurance
text: Voyager Annual Multi-Trip covers any number of trips starting from the UAE during 12 months from the policy start date. Each trip can last up to 45 days. A trip that runs longer is not covered at all for any day of that trip, not just the extra days, unless you extend it with us before it reaches 45 days. It is available to UAE residents aged up to 70 years, and a family policy covers you, your spouse and children under 21, travelling together or separately. Benefits per insured person: emergency medical expenses up to AED 1,000,000; trip cancellation up to AED 10,000 per trip; trip curtailment up to AED 10,000 per trip; checked baggage loss up to AED 3,000, with AED 750 for any one item; flight delay of AED 150 for each full 6 hours, up to AED 900; and personal liability up to AED 250,000. Excess: AED 250 per claim. Travel within the UAE is not covered. The policy meets Schengen visa requirements. Pre-existing conditions are covered only if declared and accepted. The premium is payable annually. Cancellation cover for trips already booked when the annual policy starts follows the trip cancellation rules.

title: Trip cancellation cover rules
text: Trip cancellation cover on Voyager Single Trip and Voyager Annual Multi-Trip refunds the non-refundable travel and accommodation costs you lose if you must cancel before departure for a covered reason. Covered reasons include the serious illness, injury or death of you, a travelling companion or a close relative; your home being made uninhabitable by fire or flood within 7 days before departure; a jury or witness summons; being made redundant; and a visa refusal, if you applied at least 21 days before departure. Purchase timing rule: cancellation cover applies to a trip only if the policy was bought, or your annual policy was already in force, within 7 days of the date you paid the first deposit or booking payment for that trip. If you buy later than that, the policy still covers medical, baggage and delay, but not cancellation of that trip. Many insurers let you buy cancellation cover at any time before you travel; we do not. Not covered: changing your mind, fear of travel, work commitments, airline insolvency, or any reason you knew about when you bought the policy. Claims: tell us within 48 hours of learning that you need to cancel, and cancel your bookings at once to limit the loss. Send the booking invoices, cancellation invoices showing the non-refundable amount, and evidence of the reason, such as a medical certificate. The excess is AED 250 per claim.

title: Cancelling a policy and refunds
text: Cooling-off period: for HomeShield Contents and Voyager Annual Multi-Trip, you can cancel within 14 days of the start date, or of receiving the policy documents if later, and get a full refund, provided no claim has been made. A Voyager Single Trip policy can be cancelled with a full refund at any time before the departure date, if no claim has been made. Motor policies: under UAE vehicle registration rules, a DriveGuard policy cannot be cancelled mid-term while the car is still registered in your name. You can cancel only when the vehicle is sold or transferred, exported, or its registration is cancelled, and you must send proof such as the transfer certificate or the deregistration certificate. If no claim has been made, the refund is calculated on a short-period scale, not pro rata, and an administration fee of AED 100 is deducted: cancelled within 3 months of the start, 70% of the annual premium; within 6 months, 45%; within 9 months, 20%; after 9 months, no refund. If any claim has been paid in the policy year, no refund is made. Home and travel policies cancelled after the cooling-off period are refunded on the same short-period scale, less the AED 100 fee. Refunds are paid to the original card or bank account within 10 working days.

title: Premium payments and renewal
text: You can pay premiums by debit or credit card, Apple Pay, bank transfer, or cheque at our Business Bay office. Instalments: annual premiums above AED 3,000 can be split into 4 quarterly instalments by card, with a surcharge of 5% of the premium. If an instalment fails and is not paid within 10 days, the policy is cancelled. Motor renewal: there is no grace period for motor policies. Cover ends at 11:59 pm on the expiry date shown on your schedule, and you cannot legally drive or renew the vehicle registration without valid insurance. We send renewal quotes 30 days before expiry, and you can renew up to 30 days in advance without losing any days of cover, because the new policy starts the day after the old one ends. Home and travel renewal: HomeShield Contents and Voyager Annual Multi-Trip have a grace period of 15 days after expiry, during which the policy can be renewed without a fresh declaration, but no loss or damage during those 15 days is covered unless the renewal premium has been received. Motor premiums depend on the car's value and model, the driver's age and licence history, the no-claims discount, the emirate of registration and repair costs, which are reviewed every year.

title: Contact details and office hours
text: Claims line: 800 5426, open 24 hours, 7 days a week. Roadside assistance: 800 5427, open 24 hours. Customer service: 800 5425, Monday to Friday, 8:00 am to 8:00 pm, and Saturday, 9:00 am to 3:00 pm. Email: care@liwancrest.ae, answered within 1 working day. Head office: Level 18, Marasi Bay Tower, Business Bay, Dubai. Open Monday to Thursday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm, and Friday, 8:00 am to 12:00 pm. Closed Saturday and Sunday. Abu Dhabi office: Al Muroor Road, open Monday to Thursday, 8:30 am to 4:30 pm, and Friday, 8:30 am to 12:00 pm. Al Quoz survey centre: Street 17A, Al Quoz Industrial Area 3, open Monday to Saturday, 7:30 am to 6:00 pm, for vehicle inspections by appointment, which you can book in the app. Walk-ins are accepted before 3:00 pm. Public holidays: offices and the survey centre are closed, but the claims line and roadside assistance work as normal. Complaints: email complaints@liwancrest.ae. We acknowledge within 2 working days and give a final response within 15 working days. If you are not satisfied, you may refer the complaint to the UAE insurance regulator's complaints unit.

title: Nirantar Classic plan: benefits and limits
text: Nirantar Classic is the entry-level individual and family floater plan from Tulsivan Health Insurance, sold with a sum insured of ₹3 lakh, ₹5 lakh or ₹7.5 lakh. Room rent is capped at 1% of the sum insured per day, subject to a maximum of ₹5,000 per day, and ICU charges are capped at 2% of the sum insured per day, subject to a maximum of ₹10,000 per day. If you choose a room whose daily rent is above your limit, all associated medical expenses, such as doctor and surgeon fees, nursing charges and operation theatre charges, are paid in the same proportion as the eligible room rent bears to the actual room rent. Medicines, consumables, implants and diagnostic tests are not reduced. Pre-hospitalisation expenses are covered for 30 days before admission and post-hospitalisation expenses for 60 days after discharge. Road ambulance is covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation. In-patient AYUSH treatment taken at a government-recognised hospital is covered up to ₹25,000 per policy year; AYUSH treatment as an outpatient is not covered. A co-payment of 20% applies to every claim under Nirantar Classic, whatever the age of the insured person. Pre-existing diseases are covered after a waiting period of 36 months of continuous cover. Entry age is 18 to 60 years for adults and 91 days to 25 years for dependent children. Nirantar Classic does not include maternity cover, air ambulance or restoration of the sum insured.

title: Nirantar Plus plan: benefits and limits
text: Nirantar Plus is the comprehensive plan from Tulsivan Health Insurance, sold with a sum insured of ₹10 lakh, ₹15 lakh or ₹25 lakh. There is no room rent cap: any single private room is covered at actual cost, and ICU charges are paid in full. Because there is no cap, no proportionate deduction is applied to other hospital charges. Pre-hospitalisation expenses are covered for 60 days before admission and post-hospitalisation expenses for 90 days after discharge. Road ambulance is covered up to ₹5,000 per hospitalisation, and air ambulance up to ₹2.5 lakh once per policy year. In-patient AYUSH treatment is covered up to the full sum insured. Pre-existing diseases are covered after a waiting period of 24 months of continuous cover. Maternity is covered after a waiting period of 24 months, up to ₹50,000 for a normal delivery and ₹75,000 for a caesarean delivery, and a newborn baby is covered from birth until the next renewal. If the sum insured is used up during a policy year, it is restored once, up to 100% of the base sum insured, for a later claim for an unrelated illness. Nirantar Plus has no age-based co-payment for people who join before age 61; people who join at age 61 or above pay a 10% co-payment on every claim. A zone-based co-payment may also apply; see the co-payment rules. A free health check-up worth up to ₹2,500 per adult is offered at a network diagnostic centre after every policy year. Entry age is 18 to 65 years for adults.

title: Waiting periods on all health plans
text: A waiting period is the time from the start of your first policy with Tulsivan Health Insurance during which certain treatments are not covered. Waiting periods count only while cover is continuous; if a policy lapses, they start again from the date of the new policy. Initial waiting period: no claim is payable for any illness that begins in the first 30 days of the first policy. Claims arising from an accident are covered from the first day. Specific illness waiting period: 24 months for a listed set of conditions, including cataract, hernia, benign prostate enlargement, gallbladder and kidney stones, joint replacement (unless needed because of an accident), sinusitis and varicose veins. Pre-existing disease waiting period: 36 months on Nirantar Classic and 24 months on Nirantar Plus. A pre-existing disease is any condition, such as diabetes, hypertension or a thyroid disorder, that was diagnosed or treated within 36 months before the first policy started. It must be declared in the proposal form, and undeclared conditions can lead to a claim being rejected. Maternity waiting period: 24 months, Nirantar Plus only. If you increase your sum insured at renewal, the waiting periods apply afresh to the increased portion only. Hospitalisation means admission for at least 24 consecutive hours, except for listed day-care procedures such as dialysis, chemotherapy and cataract surgery, which need less than 24 hours.

title: Cashless treatment and pre-authorisation
text: Cashless treatment is available at over 9,200 network hospitals across India. The current list, searchable by city and pin code, is in the Tulsivan app and on our website. It changes every month, so please check it before admission. At a non-network hospital you pay the bill yourself and claim reimbursement. Planned admission: the hospital's insurance desk must send the pre-authorisation request to us at least 72 hours before the admission. Emergency admission: the hospital must send the request within 24 hours of admission. With the request the hospital attaches the doctor's notes, investigation reports and the estimated cost. We give an initial decision within 1 hour of receiving a complete request, and the final discharge approval within 3 hours of receiving the hospital's final bill. If we need more information, the clock starts again when the hospital sends it. The approved amount can be enhanced during the stay if the treatment changes. At discharge you pay the hospital directly for anything not covered, such as the co-payment, non-medical items like toiletries and attendant charges, and any amount above your room rent entitlement. If cashless is denied, it does not mean the claim is rejected; you can still pay the hospital and file for reimbursement, and we will review the claim afresh. Show your Tulsivan e-card and a photo ID at the hospital insurance desk.

title: Claim intimation and reimbursement timelines, effective 1 April 2023
text: This page sets out when you must tell Tulsivan Health Insurance about a hospitalisation and when reimbursement documents are due. It applies to all policies issued or renewed from 1 April 2023. Emergency admission: intimate us within 48 hours of admission, by calling the 24-hour claims line or through the app. Planned admission: intimate us at least 72 hours before admission. Reimbursement claims: send the claim form and all documents within 30 days of discharge. Post-hospitalisation bills can be sent within 30 days of the end of the post-hospitalisation period. Late submission may be accepted if you give a written reason, such as a further hospital stay or a death in the family, and we will consider it on merit. Originals are required for all reimbursement claims, and they must be sent by courier to our claims office in Pune. We settle or reject a reimbursement claim within 30 days of receiving the last necessary document. If we take longer than this, we pay interest at 2% above the bank rate for the period of delay. You can track the status of a claim in the app or by calling the claims line with your claim number.

title: Claim intimation and reimbursement timelines, effective 1 June 2026 (replaces the April 2023 version)
text: This page replaces the claim timelines effective 1 April 2023 and applies to all claims for admissions on or after 1 June 2026. Emergency admission: intimate us within 24 hours of admission, by calling the 24-hour claims line on 1800 270 4455 or through the Tulsivan app. Planned admission: intimate us at least 72 hours before admission. Reimbursement claims: send the claim form and all documents within 15 days of discharge. This is shorter than many people expect, so please start collecting papers before you leave the hospital. Post-hospitalisation bills must be sent within 15 days of the end of the post-hospitalisation period. Late submission is accepted only with a written reason, and we decide on merit. Originals or scans: for reimbursement claims up to ₹50,000, clear scans uploaded in the app are enough, and you keep the originals for 12 months in case we ask for them. For claims above ₹50,000, originals must be couriered to our claims office in Pune or handed in at a branch. We settle or reject a reimbursement claim within 30 days of receiving the last necessary document, and pay interest at 2% above the bank rate for any delay beyond that. You can track every claim in the app or by calling the claims line with your claim number.

title: Reimbursement claim document checklist
text: For a reimbursement claim, please send the following. The claim form, part A signed by the policyholder and part B filled in and stamped by the hospital. The discharge summary. The final hospital bill with a detailed break-up, and the payment receipt. Pharmacy bills with the matching doctor's prescriptions. All investigation reports, such as blood tests and scans, with the doctor's note asking for them. For surgery, the implant sticker or invoice, if an implant was used. A cancelled cheque or bank statement page showing the account holder's name and IFSC code, for payment by NEFT. PAN card and Aadhaar or another KYC document of the policyholder, if the claim is above ₹1 lakh. For accidents, a copy of the FIR or medico-legal certificate, if one was made. For a death claim, the death certificate and the nominee's ID and bank details. Missing documents are the most common reason for delay. We send one reminder for missing items, and if they do not arrive within 15 days of the reminder, the claim is closed; it can be reopened if you send them later with a reason. Upload scans in the Tulsivan app under Claims, then Reimbursement, or courier originals to: Claims Department, Tulsivan Health Insurance, 4th Floor, Kalyani Towers, Baner Road, Pune 411045. Write your policy number and claim number on the envelope.

title: Cumulative bonus (no-claim bonus)
text: Tulsivan Health Insurance rewards claim-free years with a cumulative bonus, often called a no-claim bonus. For every policy year in which no claim is paid, your sum insured increases by 20% of the base sum insured at renewal, up to a maximum of 100% of the base sum insured. For example, a Nirantar Plus policy with a base sum insured of ₹10 lakh can grow to ₹20 lakh after five claim-free years, at no extra premium. The bonus is not a premium discount; your premium stays based on the base sum insured. Our rule after a claim is stricter than many plans. If any claim is paid in a policy year, whether cashless or reimbursement and whatever the amount, the entire accumulated cumulative bonus is withdrawn at the next renewal, and the sum insured goes back to the base amount. The bonus then starts building again from zero. Using the free annual health check-up does not count as a claim. On a family floater, a claim for any one member removes the bonus for the whole family. If you port your policy to Tulsivan, bonus earned with your previous insurer is carried over, up to the same 100% maximum. The bonus is lost if the policy lapses after the grace period ends.

title: Co-payment rules
text: A co-payment is the share of every admissible claim that you pay yourself, with Tulsivan Health Insurance paying the rest. Co-payments are applied after all other limits, such as room rent caps. Nirantar Classic: a co-payment of 20% applies to every claim, for every insured person, whatever their age. It is not limited to senior citizens. For example, on an admissible claim of ₹1,00,000, we pay ₹80,000 and you pay ₹20,000. Nirantar Plus: there is no co-payment for people who join before age 61. People who join Nirantar Plus at age 61 or above pay a 10% co-payment on every claim. Zone-based co-payment: Nirantar Plus premiums are set by zone. Zone A covers Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Kolkata, Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Pune; every other city is Zone B. If you pay the Zone B premium and take treatment in a Zone A city, an extra co-payment of 15% applies to that claim, because hospital costs in Zone A cities are higher. Emergency admissions after an accident are exempt from the zone co-payment. You can remove the zone co-payment at any renewal by switching to the Zone A premium. On a cashless claim, you pay the co-payment amount to the hospital at discharge.

title: Renewal, grace period and premium payment
text: Renewal reminders are sent by email, SMS and WhatsApp 45 days, 15 days and 3 days before your policy end date. Grace period: if you have not renewed by the end date, you have a grace period of 7 days to pay the renewal premium. This is shorter than the 30 days many insurers allow, so please renew on time. Any hospitalisation that begins during the grace period is not covered, but if you pay within the 7 days, your waiting period credit and cumulative bonus continue as if there had been no break. If you pay after the 7 days, the policy has lapsed: you must apply for a fresh policy, waiting periods start again and any bonus is lost. Premium payment modes: Tulsivan Health Insurance accepts premiums only as an annual premium, or as a single premium for a 2-year policy or a 3-year policy. We do not offer monthly, quarterly or half-yearly instalments. A 2-year policy gets a discount of 7.5% and a 3-year policy a discount of 10%. You can pay by UPI, debit or credit card, net banking, or cheque at a branch. Cheques take 3 working days to clear, and the policy is renewed only once the cheque clears. Premiums are revised by age band: 18 to 35, 36 to 45, 46 to 50, 51 to 55, 56 to 60, and five-year bands after that.

title: Porting a health policy to Tulsivan
text: Portability lets you move your health policy from another insurer to Tulsivan Health Insurance without losing credit for the waiting periods you have already served. Apply at least 45 days and not more than 60 days before your current policy's renewal date. Applications received less than 45 days before renewal are accepted only at our discretion. Send the portability form, copies of your current and previous policy schedules for all continuous years, your claim history, and the proposal form with full health disclosure. We may ask for a medical check-up, which we pay for. We decide within 15 days of receiving a complete application. Waiting period credit is given only up to the sum insured of your previous policy. If you choose a higher sum insured with us, the waiting periods for pre-existing diseases and specific illnesses apply afresh to the increased portion. For example, if you had ₹5 lakh for three years elsewhere and port to Nirantar Plus with ₹10 lakh, a pre-existing condition is covered up to ₹5 lakh straight away, but the extra ₹5 lakh is covered for it only after 24 months. Cumulative bonus earned with your previous insurer is added to your sum insured. Your old policy must stay active until the ported policy starts; any gap in cover ends portability, and the application is then treated as a new policy.

title: Free-look period and cancellation
text: Every new Tulsivan Health Insurance policy comes with a free-look period of 30 days from the date you receive the policy document, whether by email or post. During this time you can review the terms and cancel the policy if it does not suit you, provided no claim has been made. The free-look period does not apply to renewals. Refund on free-look cancellation: the premium is refunded after deducting the stamp duty paid on the policy, the cost of any pre-policy medical check-up we paid for, and a pro-rata risk premium for the days the policy was in force. It is not a 100% refund. Refunds are credited to the original payment method within 7 working days of the cancellation request. Cancellation after the free-look period: you can cancel at any time by sending a written request from the policyholder. If no claim has been made, we refund part of the premium on a short-period scale: cancelled within 3 months of the start, 75% refund; within 6 months, 50% refund; within 9 months, 25% refund; after 9 months, no refund. If a claim has been paid in the policy year, no refund is made. Multi-year policies are refunded in proportion to the complete unexpired years, plus the short-period refund for the current year.

title: Contact numbers, branch hours and grievances
text: Claims and cashless helpline: 1800 270 4455, open 24 hours a day, every day, including public holidays. General customer service: 1800 270 4400, Monday to Saturday, 8:00 am to 8:00 pm. Email: care@tulsivanhealth.in, replied to within 2 working days. WhatsApp self-service on 98200 45500 for e-cards, policy copies and claim status. Branches: Tulsivan Health Insurance has 64 branches. Branches are open Monday to Friday, 9:30 am to 5:30 pm, and on the first, third and fifth Saturdays of the month from 9:30 am to 1:30 pm. Branches are closed on the second and fourth Saturdays, on Sundays and on national holidays. You can hand in original claim documents, nominee change forms and cheque payments at any branch, and you will get an acknowledgement slip. Grievances: if you are unhappy with a reply, write to the Grievance Officer at grievance@tulsivanhealth.in. We acknowledge within 24 hours and resolve within 14 days. If the matter is still unresolved after 30 days, you may approach the Insurance Ombudsman for your area.

title: Changing your nominee, address or members
text: You can update most policy details during the policy year without any fee. Nominee: the nominee is the person who receives claim money due to the policyholder if the policyholder dies. To change your nominee, submit the signed nominee change form at any branch or upload a signed scan in the Tulsivan app under Policy, then Service requests. For security, nominee changes cannot be made over the phone or by email. The change is recorded within 7 working days, and you receive an updated policy schedule by email. Address and contact details can be changed in the app instantly, or over the phone after OTP verification. A change of city may change your premium zone at the next renewal. Adding members: a spouse can be added only at renewal. A newborn can be added mid-term within 90 days of birth by paying the pro-rata premium. Removing members: a member can be removed at renewal, or mid-term on death, divorce or a child turning 25, with a pro-rata refund if no claim was made for that member. Sum insured can be changed only at renewal, and an increase may need a medical check-up for people aged 46 or above. A change of plan from Nirantar Classic to Nirantar Plus is allowed at renewal; waiting periods already served carry over up to the old sum insured.

title: Returns for home, furniture and textiles
text: You can return home, furniture and textile items to Brackenfield Home within 30 days of purchase or delivery (60 days for Hearth Rewards Gold members) for a refund to the original payment method. Items must be unused, in their original packaging, and come with proof of purchase. Return small items to any store, or post them free using the label in your account. Large furniture is collected free of charge from your door; book the collection online or by phone. Proof of purchase: a receipt, an order confirmation email, or a bank or card statement showing the purchase all count. If you use a card statement, the refund goes back to that card. Returns without any proof of purchase: we offer an exchange or a gift card for the lowest price the item sold for in the last 28 days. Cash refunds are never given without proof of purchase. You'll need photo ID, and we accept up to 3 no-receipt returns per customer in 12 months. Mattresses, pillows and duvets can be returned only if unopened in their original sealed wrapping, unless faulty. Made-to-order sofas, armchairs and curtains are made to your chosen size, fabric or colour. You can cancel a made-to-order item free of charge within 48 hours of placing the order. After 48 hours production has started and a cancellation charge of 25% of the item price applies. Made-to-order items cannot be returned once delivered unless faulty or damaged. Ex-display and clearance items are sold as seen and can be returned within 30 days only if faulty. Refunds are made within 5 working days of the item reaching us or being returned in store; your bank may then take 3 to 5 working days to show it.

title: Returns for electricals and technology
text: Electricals and technology bought from Brackenfield Home, including TVs, laptops, tablets, small kitchen appliances, vacuum cleaners and large appliances, can be returned within 14 days of purchase or delivery if you change your mind. Unopened items: if the item is unopened, with factory seals intact, you get a full refund to the original payment method. Opened items that are not faulty: a restocking fee of 15% of the price is deducted from the refund, up to a maximum of £75. The item must be complete with all accessories, manuals and packaging, and undamaged. Laptops, tablets and phones must be signed out of all accounts and reset to factory settings, or we cannot accept them. Not returnable unless faulty: headphones and earbuds once opened, for hygiene reasons; electric toothbrushes and shavers once opened; software and games once the seal is broken; and large appliances that have been installed, plumbed in or used. Faulty items: if an item develops a fault within 30 days of purchase or delivery, you can return it for a full refund with no restocking fee, or choose a repair or replacement. After 30 days, contact us and we'll arrange a repair or replacement under the manufacturer's guarantee; if that fails, you may be entitled to a refund. Large appliances delivered by our two-person crew are collected free of charge if faulty. Change-of-mind collections of large appliances that are still unopened cost £25. Bring returns to any store with proof of purchase, or book a return in your account. Refunds are made within 5 working days of the item reaching us; your bank may then take 3 to 5 working days to show it.

title: Price Promise (effective 4 March 2024)
text: Our Price Promise, effective 4 March 2024. If you find the same product cheaper at another UK retailer, we'll match the price. The product must be identical, with the same model number, brand-new, in stock and available to buy from a UK retailer, either in a store or on the retailer's own website. Online-only retailers are included; marketplace sellers are not. You can ask for a price match before you buy, in store or by phone, or within 7 days of purchase. For claims after purchase, we refund the difference to your original payment method. Show us the competitor's price on their website or in a dated advert. The Price Promise is open to all customers. It doesn't apply to prices that require a membership or loyalty card, bundle deals, clearance and ex-display items, trade prices, or competitor prices that include vouchers or cashback. We'll match a maximum of 2 units of the same product per customer. Our staff can decline a match if they believe the competitor price is a pricing error.

title: Price Promise (effective 1 June 2026), replaces the March 2024 version
text: This version of our Price Promise applies to purchases from 1 June 2026 and replaces the Price Promise effective 4 March 2024. Who can claim: the Price Promise is now available only to Hearth Rewards members. Membership is free and you can join in store, online or over the phone before you make a claim, even on the same day. What we match: the identical product, with the same model number, brand-new and in stock at a UK retailer that has at least 10 physical stores in the UK. We match their in-store price or the price on their own website. We no longer match online-only retailers, and we have never matched marketplace sellers. When to claim: before you buy, in store or by phone, or within 14 days of purchase. For claims after purchase, we refund the difference to your original payment method within 5 working days. Exclusions: prices that require a membership or loyalty card, bundle deals, clearance and ex-display items, trade prices, finance-only prices, and competitor prices that include vouchers or cashback. We'll match a maximum of 2 units of the same product per member, and our staff can decline a match if they believe the competitor price is a pricing error. The Price Promise cannot be combined with other promotions on the same item, but Hearth Rewards points are still earned on the matched price.

title: Click & Collect
text: Click & Collect lets you order online or in the app and pick up from your chosen Brackenfield Home store. You pay online when you place the order. Cost: free on orders of £20 or more; £2.95 on orders under £20. When it's ready: items in stock at your chosen store are ready in 2 hours if you order before 4 pm during store opening hours. Items sent from our warehouse are ready the next day after 2 pm if ordered by 8 pm. Large items such as sofas and fridge freezers are not available for Click & Collect. We text and email you a collection code when your order is ready; please wait for this message before travelling. Hold period: we hold your order for 3 days from the day we send the ready-to-collect message. If it isn't collected by close of business on the 3rd day, the order is cancelled and refunded automatically to your original payment method within 5 working days. We can't extend the hold period. Collecting: show your collection code and order number at the Click & Collect desk. Anyone can collect with these for orders under £500. For orders of £500 or more, the person collecting must show photo ID matching the name on the order, unless you add a nominated collector in the app before the order is ready, in which case they show their own photo ID. Returns of Click & Collect orders follow our normal returns policy and can be made at any store.

title: Standard and next-day home delivery
text: We deliver small and medium items, such as kitchenware, bedding, lamps, laptops and small appliances, by courier across the UK. Standard delivery: £4.95, free on orders of £50 or more, delivered in 3 to 5 working days. Next-day delivery: £7.95. Order by 8 pm, Monday to Friday, for delivery on the next working day. Orders placed after 8 pm on Friday, or on Saturday or Sunday, arrive on Tuesday. Next-day delivery is not available to the remote postcodes listed below. Hearth Rewards Gold members get next-day delivery free. Working days are Monday to Friday, excluding bank holidays. Remote postcodes: the Scottish Highlands and Islands (postcodes beginning IV, HS, KW, PA20 to PA80 and ZE), Northern Ireland (BT), the Isle of Man (IM) and the Isles of Scilly (TR21 to TR25) receive standard delivery only, in 5 to 8 working days, at no extra cost. We don't deliver to the Channel Islands or BFPO addresses. Tracking: we email a tracking link when your parcel leaves our warehouse, and the courier texts you a one-hour delivery window on the morning of delivery. If you're out, the courier may leave it in a safe place you've chosen, with a neighbour, or at a local collection point for 7 days. Postcode check: enter your postcode at checkout to see which delivery options and dates are available for your address. Missing or damaged parcels must be reported within 48 hours of the delivery date.

title: Two-person delivery for large items
text: Large items, including sofas, beds, wardrobes, mattresses, TVs of 55 inches and above, and large appliances, are delivered by our two-person crew. Price: £39 per order, however many large items it contains. Orders of large items over £1,000 get two-person delivery free. Nominated day: you choose your delivery day at checkout, from the next available date up to 8 weeks ahead. Deliveries run 7 am to 7 pm, Monday to Saturday. On the evening before, we text you a 4-hour delivery window, and on the day the crew calls about 30 minutes before arriving. Remote postcodes: deliveries to the Scottish Highlands and Islands (postcodes beginning IV, HS, KW, PA20 to PA80 and ZE) carry a £30 surcharge on top of the £39 charge, so a typical order to an IV postcode costs £69 in total. These deliveries run on fixed weekly routes, so available dates are limited. We don't offer two-person delivery to Northern Ireland, the Isle of Man or the Isles of Scilly. Rescheduling: you can change your delivery date free of charge until 12 noon two working days before the delivery. After that, a rescheduling fee of £25 applies. If no one is home when the crew arrives, a failed-delivery fee of £25 applies before we rebook. Room of choice: the crew carries items to the room of your choice, unpacks them, and takes the packaging away. They can't remove doors or windows, or hoist items over balconies. Please measure doorways and stairs before ordering. Assembly is not included unless you've booked it separately.

title: Installation and recycling services
text: We offer installation when you buy a large appliance or TV from us. Book it at checkout or by phone up to 48 hours before your delivery; it's carried out by the delivery crew or a partner engineer on the same visit. Washing machines, washer dryers and dishwashers: standard installation is £45. The engineer connects the appliance to existing water, waste and electrical points within 1 metre, removes the transit bolts and runs a short test cycle. Integrated (built-in) appliances: £120, fitted into an existing kitchen housing, including attaching the cabinet door. Cabinets aren't cut or modified. TV wall mounting: £99 for TVs up to 65 inches, and £149 for 75 inches and above. The bracket isn't included and must be suitable for your TV and wall. We don't mount onto plasterboard without suitable fixings, or above a fireplace that is in use. We don't install gas appliances, connect cookers that need hard-wiring, or alter plumbing, electrics or cabinets. Gas cookers must be connected by a Gas Safe registered engineer. Removal and recycling of your old appliance: £25 per item, for one like-for-like appliance when we deliver a new one, for example an old washing machine when we bring a new washing machine. The old appliance must already be disconnected, drained and, for fridges and freezers, defrosted before the crew arrives; the crew won't disconnect or drain it. If it isn't ready, they can't take it, and the fee is refunded. Installation fees are refundable if you cancel at least 24 hours before your delivery.

title: Store information: Bristol Cribbs Causeway
text: Brackenfield Home Bristol Cribbs Causeway is our large-format store at Cribbs Causeway Retail Park, with the full furniture and appliance range on display, a Click & Collect desk, and a free 300-space car park. Opening hours. Monday to Friday: 9 am to 8 pm. Saturday: 9 am to 7 pm. Sunday: 10:30 am to 4:30 pm. Bank holidays: 10 am to 6 pm. Closed on Christmas Day and Easter Sunday. Click & Collect desk: open during store hours, closing 15 minutes before the store. Services in store: sofa and mattress showroom, kitchen appliance demo area, TV wall-mounting consultations, and a returns desk. Large appliance returns must be booked for collection and can't be brought to the store. Accessibility: step-free access, accessible toilets, and wheelchairs available to borrow at the entrance. Assistance dogs are welcome. Contact: call the store team on 0117 496 0381 during opening hours. Getting here: the store is next to the retail park bus stop, served by the 75 and 76 routes, and about 10 minutes from junction 17 of the M5.

title: Store information: Bristol Broadmead
text: Brackenfield Home Bristol Broadmead is our city-centre store in the Broadmead shopping area, focused on homeware, bedding, small appliances and technology, with a Click & Collect desk. Furniture and large appliances can be ordered in store for home delivery but aren't displayed here. Opening hours. Monday to Wednesday: 9 am to 6 pm. Thursday: 9 am to 8 pm (late-night opening). Friday and Saturday: 9 am to 6 pm. Sunday: 11 am to 5 pm. Bank holidays: 10 am to 5 pm. Closed on Christmas Day and Easter Sunday. Click & Collect desk: on the lower ground floor, open during store hours and closing 15 minutes before the store. Services in store: a tech help desk for setting up new laptops and tablets (booked in advance, from £30), small appliance returns, and gift card sales. Accessibility: step-free access via the Union Street entrance, a lift to all floors, and accessible toilets on the lower ground floor. Contact: call the store team on 0117 496 0542 during opening hours. Getting here: there is no store car park; the nearest public car parks are a 5-minute walk away. Most city-centre bus routes stop within 200 metres.

title: Care Essentials protection plan
text: Care Essentials is our breakdown protection plan for appliances, TVs and technology. You can buy it with the product or within 30 days of purchase. What it covers: mechanical and electrical breakdown from normal use, after the manufacturer's guarantee ends or alongside it, including parts, labour and call-out charges. If we can't repair the product, we replace it with one of the same or similar specification. What it doesn't cover: accidental damage such as drops, spills and cracked screens; cosmetic damage; loss or theft; batteries that wear out over time; and consumables like filters and bulbs. Length and price: Care Essentials runs for 3 years from the date of purchase. Prices depend on the product price, starting from £49 for products up to £300. There is no excess to pay on any claim. Claims: call our Care team on 03069 990218, 8 am to 8 pm Monday to Saturday, or claim online. For large appliances an engineer visits, usually within 5 working days; small items and laptops are collected and returned within 10 working days. Cancelling: you can cancel within 45 days of purchase for a full refund. After that you can cancel at any time and get a pro-rata refund for the unused months, provided you haven't made a claim. Care Essentials is not available for products bought as ex-display or refurbished.

title: Care Complete protection plan
text: Care Complete is our breakdown and accidental damage plan for laptops, tablets, phones, cameras and TVs up to 65 inches. You can buy it with the product or within 30 days of purchase. What it covers: everything in Care Essentials, plus accidental damage such as drops, spills and cracked screens, from the day you buy it. If we can't repair the product, we replace it with one of the same or similar specification. What it doesn't cover: loss or theft; cosmetic damage that doesn't affect how the product works; deliberate damage; and batteries that wear out over time. Length and price: Care Complete runs for 3 years from the date of purchase. Prices depend on the product price, starting from £89 for products up to £300. Excess: there is no excess on breakdown claims. Each accidental damage claim has an excess of £35, paid when the claim is approved. You can make up to 2 accidental damage claims in any 12 months. Claims: call our Care team on 03069 990218, 8 am to 8 pm Monday to Saturday, or claim online. Laptops, tablets and phones are collected and returned within 10 working days; TVs are repaired at home. Cancelling: you can cancel within 45 days of purchase for a full refund. After that you can cancel at any time and get a pro-rata refund for the unused months, provided you haven't made a claim.

title: Hearth Rewards membership
text: Hearth Rewards is our free membership. Join in store, online or by phone with your email address and mobile number. Green tier: everyone starts on Green. You earn 1 point for every £1 spent in store and online, excluding gift cards, Care plans and delivery charges. Gold tier: reach Gold by spending £1,000 or more in a rolling 12 months. Gold members earn 2 points for every £1, get free next-day delivery on small items, and get 60 days to return home, furniture and textile items instead of 30. Gold status lasts for 12 months from the date you qualify and renews if you spend £1,000 again in that time. Using points: every 500 points becomes a £5 voucher, sent by email. Vouchers are valid for 3 months and can be used in store or online. Points expire if your account has no purchases for 12 months. Members-only benefits: access to the Price Promise, which is only available to Hearth Rewards members since 1 June 2026; a £5 birthday voucher for Gold members; and early access to seasonal sales. Points are deducted if you return an item, and vouchers can't be exchanged for cash. If you return an item bought partly with a voucher, the voucher value is refunded as a new voucher with the original expiry date.

title: Gift cards and credit for returns
text: Brackenfield Home gift cards are available in store and online, in plastic and digital formats, with values from £5 to £500. Validity: gift cards are valid for 24 months from the date of purchase. Using part of the balance does not extend the expiry date. Check your balance and expiry on the receipt, online, or at any till. Using gift cards: in any store and online, and in combination with other payment methods. Up to 5 gift cards can be used on one online order. Gift cards cannot be used to pay for Care plans, finance repayments or other gift cards, and can't be exchanged for cash. Lost cards: we can replace a lost or stolen gift card only if you have the original receipt and the card number; the remaining balance is moved to a new card. Credit for returns: when a return is made without proof of purchase, we issue a gift card rather than a cash refund. Gift cards issued for returns are valid for 12 months. Refunds on orders paid by gift card are made to a new gift card valid for 24 months. Corporate orders: businesses buying more than £1,000 in gift cards can contact our corporate team for bulk orders and personalised cards.

title: Finance and Pay in 3
text: Pay in 3: split purchases from £50 to £1,000 into 3 interest-free monthly payments, with the first taken at checkout. Available online only, to UK residents aged 18 or over, subject to a soft credit check by our payment partner. Missed payments incur a £6 late fee, up to a maximum of £24 per purchase. Interest-free finance: on orders of £399 or more, spread the cost over 12 months at 0% APR with a minimum deposit of 10%. Available in store and online, subject to a full credit check. The finance option only appears at checkout once your basket reaches £399. Buy now pay later 12 months: on orders of £499 or more, pay nothing for 12 months. Settle the balance in full before the end of month 12 and you pay no interest; otherwise the plan converts to a 36-month agreement at 21.9% APR representative, with interest calculated from the date of purchase. Representative example: purchase price £1,000, deposit £100, credit amount £900, 12 monthly payments of £75, 0% APR, total payable £1,000. All finance is provided by our credit partner, and we act as a credit broker, not a lender. Returned items bought on finance are refunded to the finance agreement, and the remaining balance is reduced accordingly. You can settle early at any time without a fee.

title: Returns for fashion, footwear and accessories
text: Fashion, footwear and accessories bought on Tamarind Lane can be returned within 10 days of delivery. Club Elite members get 15 days. The item must be unused and unwashed, with the original brand tags and the green Tamarind Lane security tag still attached; returns without the security tag are rejected at the doorstep quality check. Raise the request from My Orders in the app or on the website. The Return button disappears at 11:59 pm on the last day of the window. Non-returnable items: innerwear, lingerie, swimwear, socks, beauty and personal care, fragrances, customised or tailored items, and gold or silver jewellery and coins. These can be reported only if they arrive damaged or wrong, under the damaged items process. Final Sale items: everything bought in the End of Season Sale, and any product marked Final Sale on its page, cannot be returned for a refund. Final Sale items can be exchanged for a different size within 10 days of delivery, subject to stock, using the size exchange process. Reverse pickup fee: a pickup fee of ₹99 per return request is deducted from the refund. Several items picked up in the same request attract the fee only once. The fee is waived for Club Plus and Club Elite members, and when the item is damaged, defective or not what you ordered. Pickups are attempted up to 2 times. If both attempts fail, you can self-ship the parcel to our returns centre in Bhiwandi, Maharashtra, and we reimburse courier costs up to ₹150 as Kosh Wallet refund balance after the parcel arrives. Refunds are initiated after the doorstep quality check; see Refund timelines by payment method for when the money reaches you.

title: Returns and replacements for electronics and gadgets
text: Electronics and gadgets bought on Tamarind Lane, including mobiles, laptops, tablets, smartwatches, headphones, speakers, cameras and small kitchen appliances such as mixers and air fryers, are not returnable for a refund. They are eligible for replacement only within 3 days of delivery, and only if the item is dead on arrival, physically damaged, defective, or different from what you ordered. Change-of-mind returns are not accepted for electronics. For mobiles, laptops and tablets, a technician from the brand or from our service partner must verify the defect before a replacement is approved. The visit is normally scheduled within 48 hours of your request. Mixers and other small appliances are verified from photos and a short video. The replacement is the identical model and colour. If it is out of stock, we refund the full amount to the original payment method instead. Return the item with its box, charger, cables, manuals and any free gifts that came with it. Before pickup, remove your Google or Apple account from phones, tablets and laptops, turn off the screen lock, and take out any SIM or memory card. A device still linked to your account cannot be accepted and the pickup will be cancelled. Accessories priced under ₹1,000, such as chargers, cables, phone cases and screen guards, are treated differently: they can be returned for a refund within 7 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging. Damage you notice on opening must be reported within 48 hours under the damaged items process, which needs an unboxing video for electronics. After 3 days, faults are handled under the manufacturer's warranty at the brand's service centre.

title: Refund timelines by payment method
text: Refunds are initiated once a returned item passes quality check. For most fashion items the check happens at your doorstep during pickup, so the refund is initiated the same day. Electronics, large items and self-shipped returns are checked at our warehouse within 2 working days of arrival. Cancelled orders are refunded as soon as the cancellation is confirmed. After a refund is initiated, it reaches you as follows. Kosh Wallet: within 2 hours. UPI: within 2 working days. Net banking and debit cards: 5 to 7 working days. Credit cards: 7 to 10 working days. The refund may show as a separate credit on your statement rather than reversing the original charge. EMI orders: the full amount is refunded to the card and your bank then closes the EMI plan. Any processing fee charged by the bank is not refunded. Gift card payments: credited back to the same gift card, which keeps its original expiry date. Kosh PayLater: the amount is adjusted against your PayLater bill within 1 working day. Cash on delivery orders: COD refunds are credited only to Kosh Wallet as refund balance, within 2 hours of the refund being initiated. We cannot transfer COD refunds to a bank account or UPI ID, and we do not issue cash refunds. Refund balance never expires and can be used on any future order. If your bank has not shown the money after the timeline above, ask our support team for the bank reference number (ARN for cards, RRN for UPI) so your bank can trace it. Working days exclude Sundays and bank holidays.

title: Cash on delivery policy (effective 1 March 2024)
text: This policy applies to orders placed from 1 March 2024. Cash on delivery (COD) is available on orders up to ₹25,000 at serviceable pincodes. A COD fee of ₹39 per order is added at checkout; it is not charged per item. The fee is waived for Club Plus members. COD is not available for gift cards, gold and silver coins, or Swift same-day orders. Pay the delivery agent in cash. Please keep the exact amount ready, as agents may not carry change. Card-on-delivery machines are available in Mumbai, Delhi NCR and Bengaluru only. If an order is refused at the doorstep, the COD fee is not charged. If 3 COD orders are refused at the doorstep within 90 days, COD is disabled on the account for 3 months. Refunds for COD orders are sent to your bank account by NEFT within 10 working days of the return being approved, after you add your bank account details under My Account. Until the details are added, the refund is held. Tamarind Lane may withdraw COD for specific products or pincodes at any time, for example during sale events or where courier partners report a high rate of refusals.

title: Cash on delivery policy (effective 1 August 2026), replaces the 1 March 2024 version
text: This policy replaces the Cash on delivery policy effective 1 March 2024 and applies to all orders placed from 1 August 2026. Cash on delivery (COD) is available on orders up to ₹10,000 at serviceable pincodes. A COD fee of ₹49 per order is added at checkout; it is charged once per order, not per item. The fee is waived for Club Plus and Club Elite members. COD is not available for gift cards, gold and silver coins, Swift same-day orders, or orders paid partly with Kosh Cash. At the door you can pay in cash or by scanning the UPI QR code shown on the delivery agent's device. Card-on-delivery has been discontinued. Please keep the exact amount ready if paying cash. The COD fee is refunded only if the entire order is returned because it was damaged, defective or wrong. It is not refunded for change-of-mind returns. If you refuse 2 COD orders at the doorstep within 90 days, COD is disabled on your account for 6 months. Prepaid payment options remain available. Refunds for COD orders are credited only to Kosh Wallet as refund balance; bank transfer by NEFT is no longer offered. See Refund timelines by payment method.

title: Delivery speeds, cutoffs and charges by pincode
text: Enter your 6-digit pincode on any product page to see whether we deliver there and the expected delivery date. A pincode is serviceable only if one of our courier partners covers it for that product; large appliances and furniture have fewer serviceable pincodes than fashion. Swift same-day delivery: available for products tagged Swift in metro pincodes of Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Ahmedabad and Kolkata. Order by 11 am and it is delivered by 10 pm the same day. Orders placed after 11 am are delivered the next day. Same-day delivery costs ₹99 per order and is free for Club Elite members. Next-day delivery: in the same metro pincodes, orders placed by 9 pm are delivered the next day at no extra charge. Standard delivery: 3 to 6 working days for other serviceable pincodes in India. Remote regions: pincodes in the north-eastern states (Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim and Tripura), Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and Lakshadweep take 7 to 12 working days. Large appliances and furniture are not delivered to these regions. Delivery charges: ₹79 on orders below ₹699, and free on orders of ₹699 or more. Club Plus and Club Elite members get free standard delivery on every order. Deliveries are attempted between 9 am and 9 pm, Monday to Sunday. There are no deliveries on 26 January, 15 August and 2 October. If you are unavailable, the courier tries 2 more times on the following days before the order is returned to us.

title: Club Plus membership
text: Club Plus is our entry membership. It costs ₹499 per year, charged upfront, and renews automatically on the same date each year unless you turn off auto-renew in My Account at least 1 day before the renewal date. Club Plus benefits: free standard delivery on every order, with no minimum order value; no COD fee on cash on delivery orders; free reverse pickup on returns, so the ₹99 pickup fee is not deducted; early access to sales 24 hours before they open to everyone; and 5% back as Kosh Cash on fashion orders, up to ₹200 per month. Price drop protection for 3 days: if the price of an item you bought drops on Tamarind Lane within 3 days of your order date, we credit the difference as Kosh Cash. Club Plus does not include free Swift same-day delivery, which costs ₹99 per order, or the extended 15-day return window, which is only for Club Elite. Cancelling: you can cancel Club Plus within 7 days of joining for a full refund if you have not used any benefit. After 7 days, or once a benefit has been used, the fee is not refunded, but benefits continue until the end of the membership year. Club Plus is linked to one account and one mobile number and cannot be shared or transferred. You can upgrade to Club Elite at any time from My Account.

title: Club Elite membership
text: Club Elite is our top membership tier. It costs ₹1,499 per year, charged upfront, and renews automatically on the same date each year unless you turn off auto-renew in My Account at least 1 day before the renewal date. Club Elite includes everything in Club Plus, and adds: free Swift same-day delivery in eligible metro pincodes (normally ₹99 per order); an extended return window of 15 days for fashion, footwear and accessories, instead of 10 days; early access to sales 48 hours before they open to everyone; 7% back as Kosh Cash on fashion orders, up to ₹500 per month; a dedicated Elite support line that answers 24 hours a day; and 2 free alterations per month on eligible ethnic wear, booked through the app. Price drop protection for 7 days: if the price of an item you bought drops on Tamarind Lane within 7 days of your order date, we credit the difference as Kosh Cash. Upgrading from Club Plus: you pay the difference for the remaining months, rounded to the nearest rupee, and your renewal date stays the same. Cancelling: you can cancel Club Elite within 7 days of joining for a full refund if you have not used any benefit. After that the fee is not refunded, but benefits continue until the end of the membership year. Club Elite is linked to one account and one mobile number and cannot be shared or transferred.

title: Cancelling an order
text: You can cancel an order free of charge while its status is Ordered or Packed, from My Orders in the app or on the website. Once the status changes to Shipped, the order has been handed to the courier and it can no longer be cancelled in the app or by our support team. If you no longer want a shipped order, you can refuse the package when the delivery agent arrives. For prepaid orders, the refund is initiated once the package is back at our warehouse, which can take up to 10 working days after you refuse it, and then follows the normal refund timelines. For cash on delivery orders nothing is charged, but refusals count towards the COD refusal limit. Swift same-day orders can be cancelled only within 15 minutes of placing the order, because they are packed immediately. Customised and tailored items cannot be cancelled once production starts, which is 24 hours after the order is placed. Multi-item orders: you can cancel individual items before they are shipped. If the remaining order value drops below ₹699, the ₹79 delivery charge is added back and deducted from your refund, unless you are a Club Plus or Club Elite member. Coupons: if you cancel an item that a coupon depended on, the coupon discount is recalculated on the remaining items. A cancelled coupon is returned to your account only if it has not expired. Orders are sometimes cancelled by us when a seller cannot fulfil them; in that case any prepaid amount is refunded in full and you receive an SMS and email.

title: Size exchanges
text: Size exchanges are available on fashion and footwear, including Final Sale items, within the return window: 10 days of delivery, or 15 days for Club Elite members (Final Sale items: 10 days for everyone). An exchange swaps your item for a different size of the same product in the same colour. To change colour or product, return the item and place a new order. Exchanges are free, and the ₹99 reverse pickup fee is not deducted on exchanges. The pickup of your original item and the delivery of the new size happen in the same visit, normally within 3 to 5 working days of your request. The delivery agent checks the tags and condition of your original item at the door before handing over the new one. Each item can be exchanged once. The replacement size cannot be exchanged again, but it can be returned for a refund within 10 days of its delivery, unless it was a Final Sale item. If the size you want is out of stock, the exchange button is not shown. You can join the size alert list or return the item instead; Final Sale items cannot be returned, so they can only wait for stock or be kept. Exchanges are not available for electronics, beauty, innerwear, or items bought with a no-cost EMI offer. Sizes of the same product are sold at the same price, so if the price has changed since your order you are not charged or refunded the difference.

title: Damaged, defective, wrong or missing items
text: If an item arrives damaged, defective, wrong or with something missing, report it within 48 hours of delivery from My Orders, then Help, then Report an issue. Reports made after 48 hours are not accepted under this process: fashion items then follow the normal return rules, and electronics are handled under the manufacturer's warranty. What we need: clear photos of the item, the product label or serial number, and the outer package showing the shipping label. For electronics, and for any order above ₹5,000, we also need an unboxing video, recorded in one continuous take starting with the sealed package and its shipping label clearly visible, without cuts or edits. Claims without a valid unboxing video for these orders are rejected. Missing items: we compare the package weight recorded at dispatch with the courier's delivery weight. Keep all packaging until the claim is closed. Wrong items: we arrange a free pickup and send the correct item if it is in stock, or refund you if it is not. Damaged or defective items: we arrange a free pickup and offer a replacement or a refund. The ₹99 reverse pickup fee is never charged on these claims, and the COD fee is refunded if the entire order was affected. Glass, ceramic and other fragile items: we recommend opening them in front of the delivery agent. You may refuse a visibly damaged package at the door; refusing it does not count towards the COD refusal limit. Decisions are usually made within 2 working days of receiving complete photos and video.

title: Kosh Wallet, Kosh Cash and gift cards
text: Kosh Wallet holds two kinds of balance, shown separately in the app. Refund balance: money from refunds to Kosh Wallet, including all refunds on cash on delivery orders and courier reimbursements. Refund balance never expires, can pay for up to 100% of any order, and can be combined with any payment method. It cannot be withdrawn to a bank account. Kosh Cash: promotional money from cashback, membership rewards, price drop protection and referrals. Kosh Cash expires 30 days after it is credited. It can pay for up to 10% of an order's value, with a maximum of ₹500 per order, and cannot be used on gift cards, gold and silver coins, or cash on delivery orders. Kosh Cash used on an order that is later returned is credited back with its original expiry date; if that date has passed, it is not restored. Gift cards: Tamarind Lane gift cards are sold in values from ₹500 to ₹10,000 and are valid for 1 year from the date of issue. Add a gift card to your account using its 16-digit card number and 6-digit PIN; the balance then appears in Kosh Wallet as gift card balance and keeps its original expiry date. A gift card cannot be used to buy another gift card or gold and silver coins, and it cannot be reloaded or exchanged for cash. Holding more than ₹10,000 in total gift card balance requires PAN verification. At checkout, the balance that expires soonest is always used first.

title: No-cost EMI, card EMI and Kosh PayLater
text: No-cost EMI: available on orders of ₹3,000 or more with credit cards from select partner banks, for tenures of 3 or 6 months. The bank charges interest, and we give you an equal upfront discount, so the total of your instalments equals the product price. The bank may also charge a processing fee of up to ₹199 plus GST, and GST on the interest component; neither is covered by the discount, and the processing fee is not refunded if you cancel or return the order. Standard EMI: tenures of 3 to 24 months on credit cards for orders of ₹2,500 or more, at the interest rate set by your bank. Debit card EMI: orders of ₹5,000 or more, for customers pre-approved by their bank. Check eligibility at checkout with your bank-registered mobile number. If you return an EMI order, we refund the full amount to your card and your bank closes the EMI plan; interest already billed is adjusted by the bank under its own rules. Kosh PayLater: a short-term credit line from our lending partner, with a limit between ₹2,000 and ₹20,000 offered after a soft credit check. Everything you buy with PayLater in a calendar month is billed together, and the full bill is due by the 5th of the next month. There is no interest if you pay by the due date. A late fee of ₹150 is charged if the bill is unpaid after the due date, and PayLater is paused until the bill is cleared. Repeated late payments are reported to credit bureaus by the lending partner. PayLater cannot be used to buy gift cards or gold and silver coins.

title: Warranty, refurbished products and customer support
text: Manufacturer's warranty: most electronics and appliances sold on Tamarind Lane carry the brand's warranty, with the period shown on the product page. Claims are made directly at the brand's authorised service centre or through the brand's helpline using your invoice, which you can download from My Orders at any time. Tamarind Lane is not a service centre and cannot repair items under brand warranty, but our support team can share service centre details. Assured Refurbished: phones, laptops and tablets sold under the Assured Refurbished label have been tested and graded by our refurbishment partner. They carry a 6-month seller warranty from Tamarind Lane, not the brand's warranty. To claim, raise a request from My Orders; we pick up the device and repair or replace it within 15 working days of pickup. If it cannot be repaired or replaced, we refund the purchase price. The seller warranty does not cover physical or liquid damage, and covers the battery only if its capacity falls below 80% of the original. Customer support: chat in the app is available 24 hours a day, every day. Phone support runs from 8 am to 10 pm, every day including Sundays and public holidays. Club Elite members have a dedicated Elite support line that answers 24 hours a day. Email replies are sent within 48 hours. When you call, keep your order ID ready. For security, we will never ask for your card PIN, CVV or OTP over the phone. The only code you should share is the delivery OTP, in person, with the delivery agent at handover.

title: Baggage allowance: domestic flights
text: This allowance applies to flights within Australia. Checked baggage: Economy Lite fares do not include checked baggage, but a bag can be added online. Economy Classic and Economy Flex fares include 1 piece of checked baggage up to 23 kg. Business fares include 2 pieces of checked baggage up to 32 kg each. Tidewater Rewards Gold and Platinum members receive 1 extra piece up to 23 kg on top of their fare allowance. No single bag may weigh more than 32 kg, and the total length, width and height of each checked bag must not exceed 158 cm. Cabin baggage: Economy passengers may bring 1 cabin bag up to 7 kg with maximum dimensions of 56 cm x 36 cm x 23 cm, plus 1 small personal item such as a handbag or laptop bag. Business passengers may bring 2 cabin bags up to 7 kg each plus a personal item. Mobility aids, a nappy bag for an infant, a coat and duty-free goods are allowed in addition. Cabin bags are weighed at check-in and may be checked in at the gate on full flights at no charge. If your itinerary includes both domestic and international flights on one ticket, the international allowance applies to the whole journey, including the domestic flights.

title: Baggage allowance: international flights
text: This allowance applies to flights between Australia and other countries. Checked baggage: Economy Lite fares include 1 piece of checked baggage up to 23 kg. Economy Classic and Economy Flex fares include 2 pieces of checked baggage up to 23 kg each. Business fares include 2 pieces of checked baggage up to 32 kg each. Tidewater Rewards Gold and Platinum members receive 1 extra piece up to 23 kg on top of their fare allowance. No single bag may weigh more than 32 kg, and the total length, width and height of each checked bag must not exceed 158 cm. Cabin baggage: Economy passengers may bring 1 cabin bag up to 7 kg with maximum dimensions of 56 cm x 36 cm x 23 cm, plus 1 small personal item such as a handbag or laptop bag. Business passengers may bring 2 cabin bags up to 7 kg each plus a personal item. Some airports, including Singapore and Tokyo Narita, weigh cabin bags again at the gate. Liquids, aerosols and gels in cabin baggage must follow the security rules of the departure airport. When your journey includes a flight on a partner airline, the allowance of the airline operating the first international flight may apply, so check the allowance shown on your e-ticket receipt.

title: Extra baggage and sports equipment
text: Extra bags: an additional checked bag up to 23 kg costs AUD 75 on domestic flights and AUD 150 on international flights when bought online in Manage Booking up to 3 hours before departure. Bought at the airport, the same bag costs AUD 110 on domestic flights and AUD 220 on international flights. Overweight bags: a bag weighing more than 23 kg and up to 32 kg, on a fare whose allowance is 23 kg per piece, is charged AUD 60 on domestic flights and AUD 120 on international flights. Bags over 32 kg must be repacked or sent as freight. All prices are per bag, per flight. Sports equipment is counted as part of your normal checked allowance and is charged at the extra bag rates only if it takes you over that allowance. Surfboards: up to 3 boards may travel in one board bag, with a maximum length of 2.77 m and a maximum weight of 32 kg, and fins must be removed. Bicycles must be packed in a bike box or bag with the pedals removed and the handlebars turned. Golf bags may hold 1 set of clubs, 1 pair of shoes and balls. Sports equipment longer than 2.77 m or heavier than 32 kg cannot be carried on Coralwind Airways flights. Scuba tanks are carried only if empty and with the valve removed.

title: Check-in and boarding times
text: Online check-in opens 24 hours before domestic flights and 48 hours before international flights. It closes 30 minutes before domestic departure and 90 minutes before international departure. Airport check-in counters and bag drop close 30 minutes before domestic flights and 60 minutes before international flights. Boarding gates close 15 minutes before domestic departure and 40 minutes before international departure. Passengers who are not at the gate by these times may be offloaded and their bags removed. Early bag drop: at Brisbane International Airport, passengers on flights departing before 9 am may drop their bags at the Coralwind Airways counter between 6 pm and 9 pm the evening before, after checking in online. Early bag drop is not available at any other airport, or for passengers with infants, unaccompanied minors or onward flights on other airlines. Passengers must carry the passport used for booking on international flights, and photo ID on domestic flights if asked. Coralwind Airways recommends arriving 3 hours before international flights and 90 minutes before domestic flights. Kiosks at Brisbane, Sydney and Melbourne airports can print boarding passes and bag tags.

title: Fare rules and change fees (effective 1 March 2025)
text: These rules apply to tickets issued from 1 March 2025. Economy Lite: changes are not permitted, and the fare is non-refundable except for government taxes, which are refunded on request. Economy Classic: date or flight changes cost AUD 99 on domestic flights and AUD 200 on international flights per passenger, plus any fare difference. Cancellation returns the fare as a travel credit minus AUD 100 on domestic flights or AUD 200 on international flights. Economy Flex: changes are free, plus any fare difference, and cancellation is refundable to the original payment method. Business: changes are free, plus any fare difference; cancellation is refundable to the original payment method minus AUD 300 on international flights. Change of mind: any fare may be cancelled for a full refund within 24 hours of purchase if the first flight departs at least 7 days after purchase. Changes and cancellations must be made before the scheduled departure of the first affected flight; otherwise the ticket is treated as a no-show and the unused fare is forfeited, apart from refundable taxes. Changes made through the contact centre carry a service fee of AUD 25 per booking; changes made in Manage Booking have no service fee.

title: Fare rules and change fees (effective 1 September 2026)
text: These rules apply to tickets issued from 1 September 2026 and replace the rules effective 1 March 2025. Economy Lite: changes are not permitted, and the fare is non-refundable except for government taxes, which are refunded on request. Economy Classic: date or flight changes cost AUD 120 on domestic flights and AUD 250 on international flights per passenger, plus any fare difference. Cancellation returns the fare as a travel credit minus AUD 100 on domestic flights or AUD 200 on international flights. Economy Flex: changes are free, plus any fare difference, and cancellation is refundable to the original payment method. Business: changes are free, plus any fare difference; cancellation is refundable to the original payment method minus AUD 300 on international flights. Change of mind: the free cancellation window is now shorter. Any fare may be cancelled for a full refund only within 4 hours of purchase, and only if the first flight departs at least 7 days after purchase. After 4 hours the normal fare rules apply; there is no 24-hour free cancellation period. Changes and cancellations must be made before the scheduled departure of the first affected flight; otherwise the ticket is treated as a no-show and the unused fare is forfeited, apart from refundable taxes. Changes made through the contact centre carry a service fee of AUD 25 per booking; changes made in Manage Booking have no service fee.

title: Name corrections and ticket transfers
text: Name corrections: if a passenger's name has been misspelt, up to 3 characters can be corrected free of charge through the contact centre, as long as the corrected name matches the passenger's passport or photo ID. A change of surname after marriage, divorce or a legal name change is also made free of charge on sight of the supporting document. Ticket transfers: unlike many airlines, Coralwind Airways allows a ticket to be transferred to a different person on Economy Flex and Business fares. A transfer costs AUD 150 per ticket, can be made only once per ticket, and must be completed at least 72 hours before the first flight departs. The new passenger takes over the existing booking, seats and fare conditions; extras that are personal to the original passenger, such as points upgrades, are cancelled. Economy Lite and Economy Classic tickets cannot be transferred to another person; if the original passenger cannot travel, those tickets follow the normal cancellation rules. Transfers must be requested by the person who made the booking, through the contact centre, which is open from 6 am to 10 pm Brisbane time, seven days a week. For international flights the new passenger must hold the passport and any visas needed for the trip, and the transfer fee is not refunded if the new passenger is refused boarding for missing documents.

title: Travel credits and refunds
text: Travel credits are issued when an Economy Classic ticket is cancelled, when a passenger chooses credit instead of a refund after a disruption, and as a goodwill gesture. A Coralwind Airways travel credit is valid for 6 months from its issue date. This is shorter than the 12 months offered by many airlines, so please note the expiry date shown in your Tidewater Rewards profile or in the email confirming the credit. A travel credit must be used to make a new booking before it expires; the new flight itself may depart after the expiry date, as long as it departs within 12 months of the credit's issue date. Credits cannot be extended, are not transferable, and can only be used for bookings that include the passenger named on the credit. If the new booking costs less than the credit, the balance stays as a credit with the original expiry date. Credits cannot be exchanged for cash.
