Vans, pick-ups and trailers longer than 1.8 metres need a free van permit, applied for online at least 5 working days before the visit, and each household can make 12 visits per year with a van permit. DIY waste such as rubble, plasterboard and bathroom fittings is accepted for a charge of £4 per bag or item, up to 5 bags per visit. Free items include garden waste, cardboard, glass, metal, textiles, small electricals, batteries and household paint. Proof of address may be asked for at the gate, and commercial waste is never accepted.

title: Brackenholt household recycling centre
text: The Brackenholt household recycling centre on Mill Lane is open to county residents. Summer hours, from 1 April to 30 September, are 8 am to 6 pm. Winter hours, from 1 October to 31 March, are 9 am to 4 pm. The Brackenholt site is closed on Thursdays all year, and on Christmas Day, Boxing Day and New Year's Day. Cars can visit without booking. Vans, pick-ups and trailers longer than 1.8 metres need a free van permit applied for online at least 5 working days before the visit, and each household can make 12 visits per year with a van permit. Brackenholt does not accept DIY waste such as rubble or plasterboard; take these to Saltmarsh Quay. It is the only site that accepts tyres, at £5 per tyre, and the only site with a reuse shop, open Friday to Sunday from 10 am to 3 pm. Free items include garden waste, cardboard, glass, metal, textiles, small electricals and batteries. Commercial waste is never accepted.

title: Household bin collections and missed bins
text: Grey general waste bins and blue recycling bins are collected on alternate weeks, and the food waste caddy is collected every week. Bins must be at the kerbside by 6:30 am on collection day and taken back in the same evening. Collections go ahead as normal on bank holidays, including Easter Monday and the August bank holiday; the only days without collections are Christmas Day, Boxing Day and New Year's Day, when collections move to the following Saturday. If your bin was out on time and was missed, report it online or by phone by 5 pm on the next working day. Missed general waste and food waste are collected within 2 working days of the report. Missed recycling is not returned for: put the extra recycling out in clear bags next to your blue bin on your next recycling day and it will be taken. Lids must close fully; bins with lids forced open by extra bags are not emptied. Replacement bins cost £28 including delivery, except where the crew damaged the bin.

title: Garden waste subscription 2026/27
text: Garden waste collection is an optional subscription and is not covered by council tax. For 2026/27 the price is £56 per bin for the year, collected every two weeks. Residents who signed up before 1 March 2026 paid the early sign-up price of £49. A second bin at the same address costs £44. Households receiving council tax reduction pay half price. The subscription runs from 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027, and joining part way through the year does not reduce the price. There are no garden waste collections from 14 December 2026 to 8 January 2027 while crews support Christmas collections; this break is already reflected in the price. Accepted: grass cuttings, leaves, hedge and shrub trimmings, small branches up to 10 cm thick, weeds and dead plants. Not accepted: soil, turf, rubble, food waste, plastic bags or plant pots, and animal waste. Subscriptions can be cancelled for a full refund within 14 days of sign-up; no refunds are given after that, including when moving house within the county, though the bin licence can move with you.

title: Bulky waste collection
text: The bulky waste service collects large household items that will not fit in your bins. A collection of up to 6 items for £38 can be booked online or by phone, and each additional item costs £6, up to a maximum of 12 items per collection. Fridges and freezers are collected separately at £24 each because they need specialist handling. Items must be left at the front of the property, outside and accessible, by 7 am on the collection day; crews cannot enter homes or gardens behind locked gates. Mattresses, sofas, wardrobes that have been taken apart, white goods and garden furniture are accepted. Not accepted: building rubble, car parts, tyres, gas bottles, asbestos and more than 4 bags of loose waste. Households receiving council tax reduction get one collection of up to 3 items free in each financial year. Bookings can be cancelled for a full refund with at least 2 working days' notice; later cancellations are refunded minus a £10 administration charge.

title: Service booking, rescheduling, cancellation and express service
text: Service appointments can be booked by phone on 020 6911 4400 for Pune and 0253 691 4400 for Nashik, by SMS, or in the Tavira Connect app, up to 30 days ahead. Each appointment is a 30-minute slot for dropping off the car. A booking can be rescheduled or cancelled free of charge up to 2 hours before the slot. A cancellation made less than 2 hours before the slot, or a no-show, is charged ₹300, which is added to the next service invoice rather than collected immediately. Bookings with pick-up follow the same rule, plus the ₹250 missed pick-up fee if the driver has already been sent. If you arrive more than 30 minutes after your slot, the slot is released and the car is taken in as a walk-in, with same-day delivery not guaranteed. Express service completes a periodic service in 120 minutes with two technicians. It is available for petrol cars only, Monday to Friday, for slots between 9 am and 2 pm, at an extra ₹500. Sunday service: the Hadapsar workshop opens on the first and third Sunday of each month from 9 am to 2 pm for periodic services and minor repairs only. Sunday visits must be booked in advance; walk-ins are not accepted on Sundays. Customers with three no-shows within 12 months lose access to express service for the following 6 months.

title: Branches, opening hours and test drives
text: Showrooms are at Baner and Hadapsar in Pune and on College Road in Nashik. Workshops are at Baner and Hadapsar in Pune and at Ambad in Nashik. Showrooms are open 10 am to 8 pm on all seven days. Workshops are open 8:30 am to 6:30 pm, Monday to Saturday, and are closed on Sundays, except that the Hadapsar workshop opens on the first and third Sunday of each month from 9 am to 2 pm. All branches are closed on Republic Day, Independence Day and the main day of Diwali. Test drives: a valid permanent driving licence is needed, and learner's licences are not accepted. Home test drives are offered within 15 km of a showroom between 9 am and 7 pm, last about 20 minutes, and a sales consultant always comes along. For the Vayu EV there is also an extended 24-hour test drive for ₹1,000, which is adjusted against the booking amount if the customer books within 15 days; it needs a licence, an address proof and a card pre-authorisation of ₹15,000. Pre-owned cars can be test driven only at the Hadapsar showroom.

title: Delivery timelines, price protection and pre-delivery inspection
text: Indicative waiting periods as of October 2026 are 2 to 3 weeks for the Kesri, 5 to 7 weeks for the Ranvi petrol, 8 to 10 weeks for the Ranvi diesel automatic, and 12 to 14 weeks for the Vayu EV. Waiting periods are counted from the date the booking amount is received and may change with factory supply. The price charged is the ex-showroom price on the date of invoicing, not the price on the booking date. Price protection exception: if we invoice the car later than the promised delivery date written on the booking form, for reasons not caused by the customer, the price on the booking date is honoured. Registration is done by us and takes 3 to 5 working days after full payment, so delivery is not possible on the day of payment. Every car gets a 72-point pre-delivery inspection (PDI) within 48 hours before delivery, and the customer may attend the PDI at the delivery bay by appointment. A new car may show up to 60 km on the odometer because of stockyard movement and the PDI road test; if it shows more than 60 km, the customer can ask for a different car. Deliveries are not done on Tuesdays at any showroom. Accessories ordered at booking are fitted before the PDI.

title: Repair estimates, approvals and vehicle storage
text: Before any work begins, the service advisor opens a job card listing the customer's complaints and gives a written estimate. For general repairs and diagnosis of complaints such as noises, warning lights or electrical faults, an inspection charge of ₹750 applies if the customer declines the estimate; it is waived if the repair is carried out at our workshop. Periodic services carry no inspection charge. Additional work found during the job is done only after approval from the person named on the job card. Additional work up to ₹5,000 can be approved verbally on a recorded phone call. If the additional amount is above ₹5,000 or more than 20 percent of the original estimate, verbal approval is not accepted; approval must be given in writing by SMS reply from the registered mobile number or by e-signature on the link we send. If the customer cannot be reached within 3 working hours, work on the extra items stops and the car is delivered with only the approved work done. The final bill may exceed the approved estimate by up to 5 percent for consumables without fresh approval. Replaced parts are kept for 7 days and handed over on request, except parts returned to the manufacturer under warranty and used batteries. Once the car is ready and the customer has been informed, it can be left at the workshop free for 2 days; after that a storage charge of ₹350 per day applies, or ₹500 per day for cars in the body shop.

title: Vayu EV high-voltage battery warranty
text: The Vayu EV's 40.5 kWh battery pack is covered for 8 years or 1,60,000 km, whichever comes first, for the first owner. The warranty covers battery failure and a drop in capacity below 70 percent state of health, as measured at our workshop. To keep the battery warranty valid, the car needs a battery health check every 12 months at an authorised Tavira workshop; the check is free when done with a periodic service and costs ₹499 on its own. For second and later owners, the battery warranty is limited to 5 years or 1,00,000 km from first registration, whichever comes first, and the transfer must be registered with us within 30 days of the sale for a fee of ₹1,500. There is no limit on DC fast charging. Exclusions: damage from water immersion deeper than 300 mm, accident damage to the battery casing, and damage caused by uncertified charging equipment. We decide whether to repair individual modules or replace the whole pack, and replacement modules may be refurbished. A 7.2 kW wall charger is installed free at one address within 25 km of a showroom for every new Vayu EV.

title: Exchange and trade-in valuation
text: Old cars of any brand can be offered in exchange at any of our showrooms. An evaluator inspects and test drives the car, which takes about 45 minutes, and gives a written valuation. The quoted price is valid for 7 days or 300 km, whichever comes earlier; after that the car must be evaluated again. An exchange bonus of ₹15,000 on the Kesri, ₹25,000 on the Ranvi and ₹40,000 on the Vayu EV is added only if the old car has been registered for at least 6 months in the name of the buyer or the buyer's spouse, parent or child. The exchange bonus cannot be combined with corporate discounts. If the old car has a loan on it, we pay off the loan from the valuation amount after receiving the lender's foreclosure letter, and any shortfall is paid by the customer. Documents needed: the RC, valid insurance, PUC certificate, loan NOC where applicable, both keys, and signed Form 29 and Form 30. A missing second key reduces the valuation by ₹5,000. The final price is fixed when the car is handed over, and traffic fines up to the handover date remain the seller's responsibility. Ownership transfer is completed within 60 days of handover.

title: Cashless insurance claims at the body shop
text: Cashless accident repairs are handled at the body shops at Hadapsar and Nashik Ambad. The Baner workshop has no body shop and only does periodic service and mechanical repairs, so accident-damaged cars brought there are sent on to Hadapsar. We have cashless tie-ups with 11 general insurers; the list is available at the service desk. To start a claim, inform your insurer and get a claim number, then bring the car with the RC, driving licence, policy copy, and an FIR where there is third-party injury or theft. The insurer's surveyor normally inspects the car within 48 working hours, and work starts only after the surveyor's approval. Even on cashless claims, a refundable advance of ₹5,000 is collected when the job card is opened. It is adjusted against the customer's share of the bill, which includes the compulsory deductible, depreciation on parts for policies without zero depreciation cover, and items the insurer does not cover. Any balance is refunded within 7 working days of the insurer's payment. If the insurer rejects or reduces the claim, the customer pays the difference before delivery. Typical body shop time is 4 to 7 working days. Panels painted in our body shop carry a 2 year paint warranty.

title: Pick-up and drop service and courtesy cars
text: Pick-up and drop is offered from the Baner, Hadapsar and Nashik Ambad workshops on working days between 8:30 am and 6 pm; it is not available on Sundays or public holidays. There is no charge for addresses within 8 km of the workshop. From 8 km to 25 km the charge is a flat ₹449 for each pick-up-and-drop round trip, including GST. Addresses more than 25 km from a workshop are not covered. Vayu EV owners get free pick-up and drop up to 25 km for as long as the battery warranty is valid. Our drivers carry a trade plate and an inspection sheet, and the customer signs the sheet recording the fuel level, odometer reading and any existing scratches or dents. If the car or keys are not ready when the driver arrives, a missed pick-up fee of ₹250 is charged. Courtesy cars: a courtesy car, normally a Kesri hatchback, is given free of charge only when a warranty repair keeps the car in the workshop for more than 48 hours, subject to availability. For paid repairs and accident repairs, a courtesy car can be hired at ₹1,900 per day including insurance but excluding fuel, with a refundable deposit of ₹10,000. Courtesy car drivers must be at least 23 years old and must have held a driving licence for at least 2 years. Courtesy cars must not be taken outside the city limits of Pune or Nashik.

title: Roadside assistance for new cars
text: New Tavira cars sold by us get complimentary roadside assistance for 3 years from the date of delivery. The 24-hour roadside helpline is 1800 266 7712. Services covered: towing to the nearest Arunodaya workshop, free up to 40 km, with ₹28 per km charged beyond 40 km; jump-starting a flat 12V battery; changing a flat tyre with the car's own spare; help with a key locked inside the car; and emergency fuel delivery of up to 5 litres, with the fuel itself billed at the pump price. Coverage area: unlike most manufacturer programmes, our roadside assistance only applies within 150 km of any Arunodaya branch in Pune or Nashik. Outside that radius the helpline will still arrange help through a partner network, but all charges are paid by the customer on the spot and are not reimbursed. The response time target is 45 minutes within city limits and 90 minutes elsewhere in the coverage area. Each car gets up to 4 free attendances per year. After 3 years, roadside assistance can be renewed for ₹1,799 per year, but only for cars that have had a periodic service at one of our workshops in the previous 12 months. Accident towing is covered on the same 40 km basis.

title: New car booking amount and cancellation refunds, effective 1 July 2026
text: This policy applies to new Tavira car bookings made on or after 1 July 2026 and replaces the booking policy dated 1 April 2024. The booking amount is ₹21,000 for the Kesri and ₹51,000 for the Ranvi and the Vayu EV, payable by UPI, debit or credit card, net banking or cheque at any showroom. The booking amount is adjusted against the final on-road price. Cancellation rules: if a booking is cancelled within 15 days of the booking date, the full booking amount is refunded. If it is cancelled after 15 days but before the car is invoiced, ₹5,000 is retained and the rest is refunded. Once the car has been invoiced, a cancellation charge of 1 percent of the ex-showroom price, with a minimum of ₹15,000, is retained, along with any registration and insurance charges already paid. Refunds are made only to the original payment source within 10 working days of the written cancellation request. Bookings paid by cheque are refunded by bank transfer after the cheque has cleared. A booking can be transferred once, free of charge, to a spouse, parent or child. Changing the variant or colour is allowed without any fee until a vehicle has been allotted to the booking.

title: New car booking and cancellation policy, effective 1 April 2024 (superseded)
text: Status: superseded on 1 July 2026 by the current booking amount and cancellation refunds policy. Kept for reference for bookings made before that date, which continue to follow these rules. The booking amount was ₹11,000 for the Kesri and ₹31,000 for the Ranvi. If a booking was cancelled within 7 days of the booking date, the full booking amount was refunded. After 7 days and before a vehicle was allotted, ₹3,000 was retained. After allotment of a vehicle, a flat ₹10,000 was retained, and after invoicing the booking amount was not refunded at all. Refunds were paid by cheque within 21 working days of the cancellation request, regardless of how the booking was paid. Bookings could not be transferred to another person under this policy, and a change of colour after allotment cost ₹2,000. Customers who booked under this policy and want to move to the current terms must cancel and rebook, which counts as a fresh booking date for the delivery queue.

title: Periodic maintenance schedule and service labour rates, effective 1 August 2026
text: This rate card applies at the Baner, Hadapsar and Nashik Ambad workshops from 1 August 2026 and replaces the rate card dated 1 April 2025. Every new Tavira car gets three free services: the first at 1,000 km or 1 month, the second at 5,000 km or 6 months, and the third at 10,000 km or 12 months, whichever comes first. At the first free service only, the engine oil and oil filter are also supplied free of charge. At the second and third free services the labour is free, but engine oil, filters and other consumables are billed at the parts price list. A free service coupon is honoured up to 500 km or 15 days past its limit; after that the service is charged at the paid rate. Paid periodic services fall every 10,000 km or 12 months, whichever comes first. Periodic service labour is a fixed ₹2,150 for the Kesri hatchback, ₹2,750 for the Ranvi SUV and ₹1,650 for the Vayu EV, which needs no oil change. General repair labour is charged at ₹1,250 per labour hour for all Tavira models. Multi-brand cars serviced at the Hadapsar used-car workshop are charged ₹1,450 per labour hour. A complimentary exterior wash is included with every periodic service but not with general repairs or body shop jobs. All labour charges attract GST at 18 percent, shown separately on the invoice. Wheel alignment is ₹650 and wheel balancing ₹90 per wheel for all models.

title: Service labour rate card, effective 1 April 2025 (superseded)
text: Status: superseded on 1 August 2026 by the current periodic maintenance schedule and labour rate card. This page is kept for reference because invoices raised before that date were calculated on it. Periodic service labour was a fixed ₹1,900 for the Kesri hatchback, ₹2,450 for the Ranvi SUV and ₹1,500 for the Vayu EV. General repair labour was ₹1,100 per labour hour for Tavira models and ₹1,300 per labour hour for multi-brand cars. Under this card the three free services covered labour only: engine oil, the oil filter and all other consumables were billed at every free service, including the first. A free service coupon was honoured up to 1,000 km or 30 days past its limit. The exterior wash was charged at ₹250 with a periodic service. Changeover rule: a car whose job card was opened before 1 August 2026 is billed at these older rates even if the invoice is raised after that date. Customers who think the wrong rate card was applied can ask the service manager for a recheck within 30 days of the invoice date.

title: New car warranty, Shield Plus extended warranty and accessories
text: Every new Tavira car carries a standard warranty of 3 years or 1,00,000 km, whichever comes first, from the date of delivery. The Shield Plus extended warranty adds cover for the 4th and 5th year, up to a total of 1,40,000 km, for ₹14,500 on the Kesri and ₹19,800 on the Ranvi, including GST. Shield Plus must be bought within 180 days of delivery and before the odometer reaches 15,000 km. Unlike the standard warranty, each Shield Plus claim carries a deductible of ₹2,500 paid by the customer, and the total of all claims during the extended period is capped at the ex-showroom price of the car. Exclusions under both the standard and extended warranty: wear and tear parts such as the clutch plate, brake pads and discs, wiper blades, bulbs, tyres and the 12V battery; damage from accidents, flooding or fuel contamination; and cars used as taxis. Shield Plus is void if a periodic service is delayed by more than 1,000 km or 30 days beyond its due point, or if any periodic service is done outside an authorised Tavira workshop. The extended warranty moves to a new owner for a fee of ₹1,000 if the transfer is registered within 30 days of the sale. Genuine Tavira accessories fitted before delivery share the car's standard warranty; genuine accessories fitted later carry a 1 year warranty from the date of fitment. Non-genuine electrical accessories void the warranty on the wiring circuits they are connected to.

title: Pre-owned car warranty for multi-brand used cars
text: Used cars of any brand sold through the pre-owned division at Hadapsar after a 160-point inspection come with a warranty of 1 year or 20,000 km, whichever comes first, from the date of sale. Unlike the new-car Shield Plus extended warranty, it covers only the engine block, cylinder head, gearbox and differential; electricals, suspension, air conditioning and the clutch are excluded. There is no deductible per claim, but the total of all claims is capped at ₹50,000 or the purchase price of the car, whichever is lower. Repairs under this warranty must be done at the Hadapsar or Nashik Ambad workshops. Cars older than 8 years, or with more than 1,20,000 km on the odometer at the time of sale, are sold without any warranty. The pre-owned warranty can be extended for a second year for ₹7,500 if bought before the first year ends, and it is not transferable if the car is sold again. Pre-owned buyers also get one free periodic service, labour only, within 6 months of purchase, and 6 months of roadside assistance on the same terms as new cars. Claims must be reported within 7 days of the fault appearing.

title: Collision center: estimates, insurance and repair warranty
text: The collision center is on the Harlan Falls campus and repairs all makes, not only Vantrell. Estimates are free. Walk-in estimates are taken on Tuesday and Thursday mornings from 8 am to 11 am; at all other times an estimate needs an appointment, which takes about 30 minutes. A written estimate is valid for 30 days. Hidden damage is often found once panels are removed, so the final bill may be higher; we will not do extra work without your approval or your insurer's approval of a supplement. You have the right to choose your repair shop. We bill your insurer directly only if the insurer is enrolled in our direct billing program; ask us to check yours. With direct billing you pay only your deductible, collected when you pick up the vehicle. With an insurer that is not in the program, you pay the full invoice at pickup and are reimbursed by your insurer. Storage charges of $65 per day begin 3 days after we tell you the repair is complete, or 3 days after an insurer declares the vehicle a total loss. All collision repairs carry a written warranty on workmanship and paint for as long as you own the vehicle.

title: Vantrell Certified Pre-Owned program
text: Vantrell Certified Pre-Owned vehicles are Vantrell models up to 6 model years old with fewer than 80,000 miles, a clean title and a passed 182-point inspection. Each certified vehicle comes with two warranties. Comprehensive coverage, sometimes called bumper to bumper, lasts 12 months or 12,000 miles from the date of your certified purchase, whichever comes first. Powertrain coverage, for the engine, transmission and drive axles, lasts 7 years or 100,000 miles from the vehicle's original in-service date, whichever comes first. There is a $100 deductible per repair visit, waived when the repair is done at one of our own service departments. Certified vehicles also get 24-hour roadside assistance for the length of the comprehensive coverage and a free first oil change within 6 months of purchase. Transfer rules: only the powertrain coverage transfers when the vehicle is sold privately, and only if a $75 transfer fee is paid within 30 days of the sale; the comprehensive coverage and roadside assistance end on the date of a private sale. If the vehicle is traded in to any Vantrell dealer, the remaining coverage stays with the vehicle at no charge. Every certified vehicle is delivered with a full detail, two keys and new wiper blades, and is sold from the Brookmere pre-owned center or online.

title: Select Assurance limited warranty on non-certified pre-owned vehicles
text: Pre-owned vehicles of other makes, and Vantrell vehicles that do not qualify for the certified program, may be sold with our own Select Assurance limited warranty, provided they are under 10 model years old and under 120,000 miles. Select Assurance covers the engine, transmission and drive axles only, for 90 days or 4,000 miles from the date of purchase, whichever comes first. There is a $250 deductible per repair visit, and covered repairs must be done at Harlan Falls or Brookmere; repairs done elsewhere are not reimbursed unless the vehicle breaks down more than 100 miles away and we approve the repair beforehand. Select Assurance does not include roadside assistance and cannot be transferred to a later owner. Vehicles over 10 model years old or over 120,000 miles are sold as-is, with no dealer warranty, and the window sticker says so. An optional extended service contract can be added to a Select Assurance or as-is vehicle at the time of sale; it is administered by a third-party company, has its own terms and deductible, and is not the same as certified coverage. Select Assurance vehicles get a 120-point inspection, a standard detail and at least one key.

title: Diagnostic fees, warranty diagnosis and recalls
text: Customer-pay diagnosis is charged at a flat $179 for the first hour. That covers most warning lights, including a steady check engine light, and includes a road test and a written report listing the trouble codes and our recommendation. Electrical faults, intermittent problems and water leaks often need longer and are billed at $179 per hour after the first hour; we will call you for approval before going past the first hour. The diagnostic fee is credited toward the repair only if you authorize the repair before the vehicle leaves our lot. If you take the vehicle home and come back later to have the repair done, the diagnostic fee is not credited, even if you return the next day, because the vehicle has to be checked again. Diagnosis is free when the fault turns out to be covered by the factory warranty, a Vantrell Certified warranty or an open recall. Recall repairs are free for every Vantrell vehicle, wherever it was bought, and we check for open recalls on every vehicle that comes in for service. Recall work needs its own appointment when parts have to be ordered; parts usually arrive within 5 to 10 business days. If a recall notice says do not drive, call us and we will tow the vehicle in from up to 50 miles at no charge and provide a loaner until the repair is done.

title: Hybrid and electric vehicle service
text: Hybrid and battery-electric Vantrell models, including the Solano Hybrid and the Lumeo EV, are serviced at Harlan Falls by technicians certified for high-voltage systems; Brookmere can do tires, wipers and cabin filters on these models but no high-voltage work. The hybrid battery on Vantrell hybrids is warranted for 10 years or 150,000 miles from the original in-service date, whichever comes first, and this coverage transfers to later owners at no charge. The Lumeo EV's high-voltage battery is warranted for 8 years or 100,000 miles against defects and against capacity falling below 70 percent. A high-voltage battery health check costs $89 and is free once a year for vehicles on a CarePath plan. Recommended EV maintenance: cabin filter every 15,000 miles, brake fluid every 3 years, battery coolant at 150,000 miles, and tire rotation every 7,500 miles; Lumeo tires tend to wear faster because of the vehicle's weight. Customers may use the two Level 2 chargers at Harlan Falls free of charge while their vehicle is in for service. If an EV arrives with less than 10 percent charge, a $20 charging fee may apply so it can be tested.

title: Financing: what to bring and how applications work
text: We arrange financing through a panel of banks and credit unions and the manufacturer's own finance company; we do not lend money directly. A credit application can be started online and is valid for 30 days, after which a new application and credit check are needed. To complete a financed purchase, bring a valid driver's license; your three most recent pay stubs, or if you are self-employed, your last two years of tax returns plus three months of business bank statements; proof of residence dated within the last 30 days, such as a utility bill or bank statement in your name; and proof of full-coverage insurance on the new vehicle, with the lender named as loss payee, before you can drive away. Retirees can bring a benefits award letter instead of pay stubs. Down payments of up to $2,500 can be made by debit or credit card; larger amounts must be paid by cashier's check, bank transfer or personal check, and a personal check over $2,500 holds the vehicle until it clears, usually 3 business days. Co-applicants must come in person to sign. The first payment is normally due 45 days after the purchase date, and none of the lenders we work with charge a prepayment penalty.

title: Hours by department and after-hours key drop
text: Harlan Falls campus, 1400 Riverside Parkway: new vehicle sales Monday to Friday 9 am to 8 pm, Saturday 9 am to 6 pm, Sunday 11 am to 5 pm. Service and parts Monday to Friday 7 am to 6 pm and Saturday 8 am to 2 pm, closed Sunday. Collision center Monday to Friday 8 am to 5 pm, closed weekends. Brookmere pre-owned center and express service, 220 Mill Street: pre-owned sales Monday to Saturday 9 am to 7 pm, closed Sunday; express service Monday to Friday 7 am to 3 pm, closed weekends. Both locations close on New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas Day. After-hours key drop: both service departments have a secure key drop box by the service entrance. Fill in an envelope with your name, phone number, mileage and the work needed, seal the key inside and drop it in the box. Vehicles left after hours are checked in the next business day and stay at the owner's risk until then, so do not leave valuables inside. Key drop is not accepted for vehicles dropped off for the collision center or for vehicles under a do-not-drive recall; call ahead for those. The main number for all departments is 555-0142.

title: Courtesy shuttle and loaner vehicles
text: Both service departments run a free courtesy shuttle within a 10-mile radius, Monday to Friday 7:30 am to 5 pm; the last pickup run to bring you back from home or work leaves at 4:15 pm. There is no shuttle on Saturdays. Loaner vehicles are provided at Harlan Falls only, and only in these cases: warranty or recall repairs expected to keep the vehicle overnight, collision repairs on insurance claims where your policy does not include a rental car, and every plan visit for holders of a CarePath Plus prepaid plan. Loaners are not provided for customer-pay oil changes, tire work or other routine maintenance; for those you can wait in the lounge, which has wifi, or use the shuttle. To take a loaner you must be at least 21, show a valid driver's license, and show proof of full-coverage insurance, which is primary while you drive it. Loaners are limited to 100 miles per day, with $0.40 per mile charged over that. Return it with the same fuel or charge level, or a refueling charge of $7.50 per gallon applies. Tolls, parking tickets and camera fines incurred during the loan are passed on with a $25 admin fee. No smoking and no pets; a cleaning fee of $150 applies. Loaners must be returned within 24 hours of your own vehicle being ready, after which $45 per day is charged.

title: Factory orders, deposits and price protection
text: New Vantrell vehicles that are not in our inventory can be ordered from the factory through the Harlan Falls sales team. A factory order needs a $1,000 deposit, paid by debit card, credit card or cashier's check. The deposit is fully refundable until the order is scheduled for production, which usually happens within 10 days and is confirmed to you by text and email. Once the order is scheduled, the deposit is non-refundable, but it can be applied to any other new or pre-owned vehicle purchase from us within 6 months. If the vehicle arrives more than 90 days after the estimated build week we gave you, you may cancel and the deposit is refunded in full. Price protection: the agreed price on the order is not locked. If the factory raises the MSRP before your vehicle is built, the increase is passed on at cost, and we will tell you in writing before delivery; if the increase is more than $1,000 you may cancel for a full refund of the deposit. If the factory lowers the price or adds an incentive, you get the lower price. Delivery is at Harlan Falls with a one-hour orientation; home delivery within 40 miles costs $150. In-stock vehicles can be held for 48 hours with a separate $500 refundable deposit.

title: CarePath prepaid maintenance plans
text: CarePath plans let you pay for scheduled maintenance upfront at today's prices. CarePath Basic costs $599 and covers 4 full synthetic oil changes with tire rotation and multi-point inspection over 3 years or 30,000 miles, whichever comes first. CarePath Plus costs $1,149 and covers 6 visits over 4 years or 45,000 miles, adding engine and cabin air filters every other visit, one brake fluid exchange, wiper blades once a year and a loaner vehicle at every plan visit. Plans can be bought with a new or pre-owned vehicle, or within 90 days of purchase for any Vantrell vehicle under 15,000 miles, and can be included in a vehicle loan. Plans are honored only at the Corrigan & Pike service departments in Harlan Falls and Brookmere. CarePath plans are non-refundable once the first plan service has been used, including when the vehicle is sold, traded in or declared a total loss. Instead, the remaining visits transfer automatically and free of charge to the next owner of the vehicle, whether that is a private buyer or a dealer. If no plan service has been used, a plan can be cancelled within 60 days of purchase for a full refund. Unused visits do not roll over once the time or mileage limit is reached. Any repairs found during a plan visit are quoted separately and are not covered by the plan.

title: Service menu and maintenance intervals, effective 1 March 2026
text: This menu applies at both service departments, Harlan Falls and Brookmere, from 1 March 2026 and replaces the menu dated 1 January 2024. Prices include parts, labor and shop supplies but not sales tax. Full synthetic oil and filter change: $94.95 for Vantrell gasoline engines taking up to 6 quarts, and $129.95 for the Tarrant 3.5 V6 and all diesel engines. Conventional oil is no longer offered, because every Vantrell engine built since 2019 requires 0W-20 or 0W-30 full synthetic. Every oil change includes a tire rotation and a multi-point inspection at no extra charge. Tire rotation on its own is $39.95. Engine air filter $54.95; cabin air filter $64.95. Brake fluid exchange $159.95, recommended every 3 years regardless of mileage. Coolant exchange $199.95, first at 100,000 miles and then every 50,000 miles. Four-wheel alignment $149.95. Maintenance intervals: Vantrell's schedule calls for an oil change every 7,500 miles or 12 months, whichever comes first, under normal driving. Under severe service, meaning regular towing, mostly trips under 5 miles, dusty or gravel roads, or long periods of idling, the interval drops to 3,750 miles or 6 months. The oil life monitor can be followed instead, but never beyond 12 months between changes. Express oil changes without an appointment are available at Brookmere only, Monday to Friday 7 am to 3 pm.

title: Service menu, effective 1 January 2024 (superseded)
text: Status: superseded on 1 March 2026 by the current service menu. This page is kept for customers checking older invoices and service records. Under the 2024 menu, a full synthetic oil and filter change cost $84.95 for gasoline engines and $114.95 for the Tarrant V6 and diesel engines. A conventional oil change was still offered at $59.95 for models built before 2019. Tire rotation was charged separately at $29.95, even when done with an oil change. Engine air filter $49.95; cabin air filter $59.95. Brake fluid exchange $139.95, recommended every 2 years. Four-wheel alignment $129.95. The oil change interval printed on this menu was 5,000 miles or 6 months for normal driving and 3,000 miles for severe service; Vantrell lengthened its factory schedule in 2025, and the current menu reflects the new intervals. Service coupons issued under the 2024 menu are honored until 31 May 2026, but they are applied to the current prices, not the old ones. Express service at Brookmere under this menu ran Monday to Saturday; Saturday express service ended when the current menu took effect.

title: Seasonal tire changeover and tire storage
text: Tire storage is offered at the Brookmere service department only. Storage costs $119 per season for a set of four tires, mounted on wheels or not, and includes cleaning, a tread and pressure check, and storage in a climate-controlled room. Winter tires are stored from 1 April to 31 October, and summer or all-season tires from 1 November to 31 March. A seasonal changeover when your other set is already mounted on wheels costs $69, including a tire pressure monitor reset. If the tires have to be dismounted and mounted on one set of wheels, it costs $139 including balancing. Changeover appointments must be booked at least 3 business days ahead, and no walk-in changeovers are done between 15 October and 15 December. Tires left in storage more than 30 days after the end of their season are charged $25 per month, and tires still unclaimed 6 months after the season ends are disposed of after one written notice. We will not store tires with less than 4/32 inch of tread left; we will recommend replacing them instead. Tire storage customers get 10 percent off new tires bought from us.

title: Trade-in appraisals
text: A trade-in appraisal is done in person at either location and takes about 30 minutes, including a short test drive. The online trade estimate tool gives a range only and is not an offer. A written appraisal is valid for 5 days or 250 miles, whichever comes first, and only toward a vehicle purchase from us. We also buy vehicles outright without a purchase, but a cash offer is valid for 3 days and is usually lower. The appraisal assumes the condition seen on the day, so new damage or new warning lights cancel it. Bring the title, or if there is a loan, the lender's name, your account number and a 10-day payoff letter; we pay off the loan directly, and any positive equity goes toward your purchase. Negative equity can be added to a new loan, subject to lender approval, or paid at signing. A missing second key reduces the offer by $300, and a missing owner's manual or navigation card by $50 each. All registered owners must sign the title at the time of trade. Leased vehicles can be traded in with a written buyout quote from the leasing company.

title: Pre-owned vehicle 7-day exchange promise
text: Every pre-owned vehicle we sell, certified or not, comes with a 7-day exchange promise, except vehicles sold as-is. If you are not happy with the vehicle for any reason, you can bring it back within 7 days of delivery and 300 miles, whichever comes first, and exchange it for another vehicle from our pre-owned stock. This is an exchange, not a return: no cash refunds are given, and the full purchase price, including any trade-in allowance, is credited toward the replacement vehicle. If the replacement costs more, you pay or finance the difference; if it costs less, the difference is refunded by check within 10 business days. The vehicle must come back in the same condition as at delivery, with no new damage, no aftermarket modifications, and all keys, manuals and accessories. A $295 exchange processing fee applies, which covers re-titling and re-registration. Only one exchange is allowed per purchase. Exchanges are handled at the Brookmere pre-owned center by appointment, Monday to Saturday. Federal law does not give buyers a cooling-off period on vehicle purchases; this promise is our own policy, and its terms are set out in the buyer's agreement you sign at delivery.
